opportunity_definitions.attack: Planter can reach an enemy tree (stay included), has seize cash before joint actions, and at least two turns of tree life and game remain.
opportunity_definitions.cargo_defense: Positive-load collector staying is exposed to an equal/lighter enemy collector; a reachable alternative free of resident friendly workers and of this threat exists. Excludes enemy-base-adjacent roots.
opportunity_definitions.tree_defense: A collector can reach a live own tree also reachable this step by an enemy planter with cash to seize; at least two turns of tree life and game remain.
opportunity_definitions.no_tactical_opportunity: Valid expert slot with neither attack nor defense opportunity; normal economy and other decisions remain in BC.
